title: Apple App Store App Details Scraper
description: Apple App Store App Details Scraper collects structured data from Scrappa's /apple/app-store/details endpoint. Submit multiple inputs in one Actor run and receive one dataset item per result. Submit multiple batch entries in one run.

product_ids.title: Product Ids
product_ids.description: Batch input entries. Each product_id is sent as the product_id value.

product_id.title: Product ID
product_id.description: Apple product id (numeric adam id; UMC ids also accepted for movies/TV)

store.title: Store
store.description: Store vertical: apps, mac, books, audiobooks, movies, tv, music, or podcasts

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter Apple storefront country code (default: us)

season_id.title: Season ID
season_id.description: TV season id; returns the season product instead of the show

num.title: NUM
num.description: Requested review result count per page

next_page_token.title: Next Page Token
next_page_token.description: Review pagination token from a previous response
